ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white/light-gray interior field (~75%) contrasted against low-intensity dark gray/black margins and focal spots (~25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity continuous band following the trailing edge topography. Vertical low-intensity bisection at the median notch. Cluster of approximately 6-7 circular low-intensity blobs on the medial left lobe. Single distinct circular low-intensity spot on the distal right lobe. High-density dark mottling at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees, showing significant pixel depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Variable pixel-amplitude peaks, particularly pronounced on the left lobe medial-to-distal section. Notable jagged indentation on the outer right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Roughly linear trailing edges with a slight upward (cranial) convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Constellation of five distinct dark circular pixel clusters arranged in a loose diagonal on the inner left lobe; one isolated dark circular cluster on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white intensity fields of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major V-shaped indentation/tissue loss on the outer margin of the left lobe tip, distinct from natural serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial alignment of focal spots on the left lobe medial region coupled with a significant terminal amputation on the far left lobe tip.
